title: Thai Beef Satay Skewers
description: A classic Thai dish featuring marinated beef skewers grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of peanut sauce for dipping.
instructions: 1. Soak 10 bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes.
2. In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, lemon juice, and garlic. Blend until smooth.
3. Add the beef sirloin tips to the marinade and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
5. Thread the marinated beef onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Brush the skewers with vegetable oil and season with salt.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
8. Meanwhile, make the peanut sauce by blending together toasted peanuts, 1/4 cup of coconut milk, and 2 tbsp of fish sauce.
9. Serve the grilled beef skewers with peanut sauce for dipping.
